mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_dept d WHERE d.is_deleted = 0 AND d.parent_id > 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dept_closure c WHERE c.descendant_id = d.id AND c.ancestor_id = d.parent_id AND c.depth = 1)

SELECT d.id, d.dept_name, d.parent_id FROM sys_dept d WHERE d.is_deleted = 0 AND d.parent_id > 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dept_closure c WHERE c.descendant_id = d.id AND c.ancestor_id = d.parent_id AND c.depth = 1) ORDER BY d.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_dept child JOIN (SELECT descendant_id, COUNT(*) AS closure_cnt FROM dept_closure GROUP BY descendant_id) child_cnt ON child_cnt.descendant_id = child.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT descendant_id, COUNT(*) AS closure_cnt FROM dept_closure GROUP BY descendant_id) parent_cnt ON parent_cnt.descendant_id = child.parent_id WHERE child.is_deleted = 0 AND child.parent_id > 0 AND child_cnt.closure_cnt <> (COALESCE(parent_cnt.closure_cnt, 0) + 1)

SELECT child.id, child.dept_name, child.parent_id, child_cnt.closure_cnt AS child_closure_cnt, parent_cnt.closure_cnt AS parent_closure_cnt, (COALESCE(parent_cnt.closure_cnt, 0) + 1) AS expected_child_cnt FROM sys_dept child JOIN (SELECT descendant_id, COUNT(*) AS closure_cnt FROM dept_closure GROUP BY descendant_id) child_cnt ON child_cnt.descendant_id = child.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT descendant_id, COUNT(*) AS closure_cnt FROM dept_closure GROUP BY descendant_id) parent_cnt ON parent_cnt.descendant_id = child.parent_id WHERE child.is_deleted = 0 AND child.parent_id > 0 AND child_cnt.closure_cnt <> (COALESCE(parent_cnt.closure_cnt, 0) + 1) ORDER BY child.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT SUM(IF(cnt = 0, 1, 0)) AS zero_closure, SUM(IF(cnt = 1, 1, 0)) AS only_self, SUM(IF(cnt > 1, 1, 0)) AS has_ancestors, COUNT(*) AS total FROM (SELECT d.id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dept_closure c WHERE c.descendant_id = d.id) AS cnt FROM sys_dept d WHERE d.is_deleted = 0) x
